summary: Man and teenage son left the trailhead at 10 a.m. June 19 aiming for Quandary Peak's West Ridge with a planned traverse down the east ridge; cliffed out ~8 p.m. and called for help. Summit County Rescue Group sprang into action; a Flight For Life helicopter dropped a rescue team on east Quandary at dusk. Rescuers reached the pair on the summit (14,271 ft) and spent the night with them (tent, warm clothes); uninjured but exhausted and cold. Early next morning a Black Hawk hoisted both to safety after winds scuttled two overnight attempts; everyone off the mountain by 11:30 a.m.
responding_agency: Summit County Rescue Group; Summit County Sheriff's Office
